description: This file defines the interface for cryptographic operations in the easyconnect namespace, including functions for key derivation, hash computation, EC point encoding/decoding, key exchange, and JSON Web Key handling. It also declares the ec_crypto class with static methods for cryptographic processing, elliptic curve operations, and JSON Web Signature handling, tailored for use in secure wireless communication protocols.

classes.name: ec_crypto
classes.description: A utility class encapsulating cryptographic operations such as key derivation, hashing, elliptic curve point management, secure memory handling, and JSON Web Signature/Key processing tailored for secure wireless communication protocols.

methods.name: hkdf
methods.description: Derives a cryptographic key using HKDF with the specified hash function and input parameters.

methods.name: compute_key_hash
methods.description: Computes the hash of a given key, optionally with a prefix.

methods.name: init_connection_ctx
methods.description: Initializes a connection context using the group from the bootstrapping key.

methods.name: compute_hash
methods.description: Hashes a buffer of elements using a specified hash function.

methods.name: compute_ke
methods.description: Computes the key exchange (KE) value within a connection context.

methods.name: compute_hkdf_key
methods.description: Performs a flexible HKDF operation, handling multiple inputs and formatting BIGNUMs appropriately.

methods.name: calculate_Lx
methods.description: Calculates the x-coordinate of point L based on elliptic curve point operations.

methods.description: Retrieves the affine x and y coordinates of an EC point.

methods.description: Extracts the x-coordinate from an EC point.

methods.description: Decodes a protocol buffer into an EC point.

methods.description: Computes the X coordinate of the shared secret for a key exchange.
